task.title: Refresh the Library
task.shortdesc: Reload Library rows and interpret load or action status before repeating an operation.

prereq.p: The Library is open, and you need to confirm current saved profile state after a change or failed load.

context.p: Refresh reloads the Library from BPM. It does not validate profiles or save unsaved editor changes.

info.p: Expected result: the status announces loading and then either a refreshed list or an error.

step.cmd: Wait for the status message before starting another Library action.

info.note: Repeating lifecycle or delete actions while the status is unresolved can make it harder to tell which operation failed.

step.cmd: Review filtered and total counts after refresh.

info.p: Counts can change if another tab saved, archived, restored, or deleted a profile.

result.p: The Library view reflects the latest profile list available to BPM.

postreq.p: Recovery: if refresh fails, keep the current page open and use the troubleshooting topic to decide whether to retry or preserve context.
